events.verdict: Anunoby (NYK) legally contests McCollum's (ATL) shot attempt.
Okongwu (ATL) and Towns (NYK) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
Daniels (ATL) moves alongside Brunson's (NYK) path as he defends the drive.
Daniels (ATL) legally contests Brunson's (NYK) jump shot attempt.
Hart (NYK) deflects the ball away from Johnson (ATL) as they pursue the rebound.
Hart (NYK) gathers while he is airborne and takes two steps prior to releasing the pass.
Towns (NYK) firms up over his left leg in Daniels' (ATL) path prior to the contact.
Okongwu (ATL) momentarily applies his hands to Brunson's (NYK) front as he defends the drive.
Brunson (NYK) establishes his right foot as his pivot foot, which he moves after his gather.
Okongwu (ATL) avoids making contact with Brunson's (NYK) arm as he defends the shot attempt.
Okongwu (ATL) establishes himself in Brunson's (NYK) path prior to the contact.
Towns (NYK) contests Alexander‑Walker's (ATL) jump shot and the contact after the release is marginal.
Hart (NYK) establishes himself in Alexander-Walker's (ATL) path prior to the contact.
McCollum (ATL) directly contests Brunson's (NYK) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Brunson's hand after the release.
Towns (NYK) and Daniels (ATL) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
Hart (NYK) moves alongside Johnson's (ATL) path as he defends the drive.
Hart (NYK) momentarily applies his forearm to Johnson's (ATL) side and he immediately removes his forearm as Johnson enters his upward shooting motion.

McCollum (ATL) initiates contact with Anunoby (NYK) that affects his shot attempt.  After communicating with the Replay Center, it was determined that the contact did not meet the criteria for a flagrant, or clear path, foul.  During the review, it was also determined the contact occurs after Anunoby's gather and a shooting foul is assessed.
Okongwu (ATL) briefly grasps Anunoby's (NYK) arm as he sets the screen.
Daniels (ATL) commits a take foul on Brunson (NYK).
Anunoby (NYK) and Alexander-Walker (ATL) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the court (no basket) is confirmed.  McCollum (ATL) does not release his shot attempt prior to the expiration of the game clock.
